assets.statement: L1-as-branch-B-evidence fails: Maynard bound is subsequence-only (hidden-subsequence attack) and does not match the quantifier reversal of o(log N) (needs all-N failure at positive density, not infinitely many N); repair = uniform c·log N lower bound on the full primes, an equivalent-strength open p

Vacuous subset fact, coprimality and both target sums never used; quantifier slip (∃-level fact offered for ∀-level proposition) and circularity confirmed; route R005 has no standing reduction and must produce a genuine bound or separating family.

no explicit mathematical sentence stated on the node so all twelve attacks return no target; per D0 the machine-verified counterexample stands on record, and repair requires restating L1 as a concrete sentence with explicit witnesses and range before any route can close

k=1 endpoint counterexample on A=ℕ (F=X−1>X^{1/2}) plus prior sampled-to-universal defect (A={2^n} only); repair requires ∃k(a,ε) quantifier order and a ∀A proof of the chosen-k bound; R007 remains without a quantitative engine.

refuted at smallest parameters: r=2, k=2 family I₁={2,3}, I₂={24,25} gives total product 3600=60², exactly verified; Pell a(a+1)=6t² yields infinitely many length-2 square-product blocks, so k=2 imposes no obstruction and any close must use a fixed r across all k≥2 with explicit integrality.

Gaussian prime 3 has no Gaussian prime at unit distance (2,4,3±i all composite), so L1 fails; repair requires step bound √2, which still leaves the canonical infinite-path/moat question open in both branches.
